ml-nightly-bot: [ALERT] nightly-eval job finished 2026-03-19 05:12:01 UTC - model rdx-llama-q4-nightly v2 - 82/1000 failures (8.2%) — majority are function-call responses failing JSON schema (args parse error).

anya: ugh, I see it too. lots of entries where 'steps' is a quoted string instead of an array.

anya: sample output:
```json
{"id": "req-42", "tool": "planner", "output": {"steps": "[{\"op\":\"call_api\",\"args\":{\"url\":\"https://example.com\"}}]", "result": null}}
```

prashant: that's serialization happening somewhere after generation. could be the postprocessor that sanitizes newlines + our kvcache serializer. :thinking_face:

tori: I reproduced on my laptop with q4 quantize profile + decode_strict=true. with decode_relaxed it returns an actual array. maybe quantization changed tokenization for brackets/quotes.

sam: can someone grep nightly logs for 'tool":"planner' and 'steps": "' to see earliest regressed commit? I'll kick off a log search.

ml-nightly-bot: log search job: https://ci.internal/jobs/55823 — initial regression around 2026-03-10 12:03 UTC (commit d3fa7b2)

anya: omg that commit was the new kvcache encode change. @prashant can you check the encode_path handles nested lists correctly?

prashant: on it. quick thought: encode_path adds escape sequences for JSON to prevent injection, but when we later run JSON.stringify in postprocessor it's escaping twice. probable double-escaping.

eva: temporary mitigation: nightly eval should run a schema-strict sanity step that tries to parse 'steps' if it's a string and warn separately instead of failing the whole eval count. we can roll that for one night to reduce noise.

tori: agreed. also adding a unit test for kvcache encode/decode with nested structures.

sam: thanks. I'll open an infra ticket to add the sanity parser + add a grep job to attach samples to the eval bug.

prashant: will submit a PR to revert the encode change until we fix double-escape. sending patch now.

anya: thanks team. keep updates here. :eyes:
